indications: Lidovara™ is indicated for topical analgesia as directed by a healthcare provider.
contraindications:
For topical use only.
                     
Apply to the affected area 3 to 4 times daily or as directed by a healthcare provider.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Lidovara™ (Lidocaine Hydrochloride 28 mg/g) is supplied as a clear topical gel in a 3.5 oz (100 g) tube.
                     
NDC 85477-303-07
adverseReactions: Lidovara™ is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to lidocaine or any component of the formulation.
name: Lidovara
